description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for managing D3D11 textures on Windows within the media GPU component, including Texture2DWrapper and DefaultTexture2DWrapper classes.

classes.name: Texture2DWrapper
classes.description: Abstract interface for wrapping and managing D3D11 textures, supporting initialization, shared image access, and texture processing.

classes.name: DefaultTexture2DWrapper
classes.description: Concrete implementation of Texture2DWrapper that manages GPU resources and interacts with hardware textures on Windows.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the texture wrapper with GPU resources and parameters.

methods.name: BeginSharedImageAccess
methods.description: Prepares the shared image for access, ensuring proper synchronization.

methods.name: ProcessTexture
methods.description: Imports the texture and returns mailbox references for sharing.

methods.name: SetStreamHDRMetadata
methods.description: Sets HDR metadata for the stream.

methods.name: OnGPUResourceInitDone
methods.description: Callback invoked when GPU resource initialization is complete.
